steps.name: Step 1 — Create a pipeline with a Decision node, added FIRST (before any other node) so it becomes the pipeline's entry point
Step 2 — Add three Printer nodes as branch targets, rename them, and give each a distinct PRINTER Value (the branch's observable 'which branch fired' signal)
Step 3 — Configure the Decision node: Input includes the built-in 'input' variable, Description holds the classification prompt, and all three DECISION OUTPUTS are wired via drag-connect
Step 4 — Connect the remaining edges: each branch node -> END, and Decision's Default output handle -> END
Step 5a — Save the pipeline; verify no console errors and a 201 Created response
Step 5b — Reload via the canonical URL; entry_point, DECISION OUTPUTS chips, all 7 edges (post-reload testid shape), and both Printer Values persist
Step 6a — Send a bug-report-shaped message via the embedded chat; verify execution routes to the bug_responder branch
